title: ML final experiment evidence v2
description: Hash-bound final experiment evidence for the ML adapter. v2 deliberately narrows kind to experiment_run and adds an explicit final-evaluation partition plus split pin. The partition vocabulary admits train/validation as schema-legal unsafe declarations so the adapter's protected-partition rule remains falsifiable; only test or future_holdout can support a final generalization report. Non-experiment evidence continues to use the frozen ml-evidence/v1 family.

seeds.description: All seeds represented by the result artifact. Stability is judged from the unique set, never a best-only value.

partition.description: Partition reported as the final evaluation. train/validation stay schema-legal for semantic negative fixtures.

split_sha256.description: Split declaration pin used for the reported partition; must equal the case-derived contract pin.
